howItWorks.title: How to fund your Getly USD wallet
howItWorks.subtitle: Start spending globally in less than 2 minutes directly from your mobile device.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Select your domestic currency (NGN, GHS, KES, ZAR, EUR, GBP, CAD, etc.) and enter how much USD you want to fund.
howItWorks.step2Title: Pay with any Visa or Mastercard
howItWorks.step2Desc: Use your regular domestic debit or credit card. Confirm the payment with seamless 3D-Secure two-factor verification.
howItWorks.step3Title: Instant USD balance ready to travel
howItWorks.step3Desc: Your USD wallet is credited immediately. Instantly fund virtual cards, book flights, reserve hotels, and activate eSIMs.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about the USD Wallet
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about domestic card funding and global spending.
faq.q1: Can I fund my USD wallet with any local Visa or Mastercard?
faq.a1: Yes! You can use any standard domestic debit or credit card issued in your country (including NGN, GHS, KES, ZAR, EUR, GBP, CAD, etc.). Your issuing bank charges in your local currency, and Getly instantly credits your wallet in USD.
faq.q2: How quickly will the USD balance appear in my wallet?
faq.a2: Wallet funding settles in real time. As soon as you authenticate your card payment via 3D Secure, your USD balance updates within seconds.
faq.q3: What can I spend my USD wallet balance on?
faq.a3: Your USD balance can be used directly across the entire Getly ecosystem: creating and loading Virtual Travel Cards (for online and in-store spending), booking flights, reserving hotels, purchasing global eSIM data packs, and getting travel insurance.
faq.q4: Are there limits on how much I can fund?
faq.a4: Limits are determined by your profile verification tier. Completing basic digital verification unlocks standard travel limits, while full biometric verification provides high-limit global traveler tiers.
faq.q5: Can I withdraw funds from my wallet if my plans change?
faq.a5: Yes, Getly provides flexible withdrawal options allowing you to return funds to your connected payout channels whenever needed.
